about.intro: The Soap Opera was born from a wisdom that has continued for centuries in the stone streets of Gaziantep, in the shadow of olive trees.
about.paragraph1: In these lands, soap was part of a way of life where time flowed slowly, labor was considered sacred, and harmony with nature was at the center of life. These soaps, kneaded with olive oil, touched not only the body but also the soul.
about.paragraph2: Traditional olive oil soap has served not just a simple purpose over the years, but purification, healing, and self-care.
about.quote: "For us, true cleanliness means leaving no trace behind."
about.paragraph3: As sisters carrying this heritage, we began to rethink the silent mastery of the past with today's world. We believe that soap is the simplest ritual that reminds us of the connection we have with nature and naturalness.
about.paragraph4: That's why at The Soap Opera, we only use natural, vegan, and conscious ingredients; we prioritize a balance that respects nature and considers future generations at every stage of production.
about.highlight: We are part of a narrative fed by ethnic roots, shaped by an artistic vision, and blended with innovation. Today, as we adapt traditional olive oil soap to the rhythm of modern life, we reinterpret it not just as a functional product, but as an experience that appeals to the senses and adds meaning to everyday life.
about.paragraph5: We believe in the transformative power of women entrepreneurship. The Soap Opera is a brand that thinks beyond production; it develops, changes, and is open to new possibilities. Every step we take today is the beginning of more innovative, more creative, and more conscious projects we plan to bring to life tomorrow.

footer.brand_description: A journey respectful of the past, sensitive to the present, and hopeful for the future. Quiet but powerful. Simple but profound.
footer.tagline: The only drama you need is in the bubbles.
